lina_cs: FYI Northfold renewal in ~5w. Their UI sessions with long multi-turn flows show big tail latency and XPU spikes. Want to propose a short canary: int8 quant + split routing by token-length. Goal: >=15% cost cut, <3% quality drop.

matt_se: Agree. Plan: route requests with tokens>600 to rwd-compact-13b-int8 (kv cache enabled). Shorter ones go to rwd-tiny-6b. Keep fp16 for policy/legal prompts.

jamal_sre: Quick numbers: 24h 95p for long flows = 3.9s, avg CPU/GPU 88-94%. Int8 should reduce token time ~22% on our kernels; KV cache helps multi-turns. Need to reserve extra workspace memory on nodes.

matt_se: Canary YAML (short):
```
routes:
 - name: northfold-long-canary
   match: request.tokens > 600
   variants:
     - model: rwd-compact-13b-int8
       weight: 30
     - model: rwd-13b-fp16
       weight: 70
   fallback: rwd-13b-fp16
```
Run 48h, track token_latency_ms, cost_per_call, and eval passrate.

zoe_pm: I'll prep a 40-sample eval from their recent logs and a 3-question customer survey (latency, quality, accept trade?). Also schedule an enablement call with their SRE next Wed.

jamal_sre: Ops checklist: spin 2x int8 instances, enable prefix caching for sessions>1 turn, wire up per-variant $/1k tokens tag, alert if error_rate>1.5%.

deploy-bot: Canary northfold-long-canary deployed at 2024-09-02T11:05:00Z (instances:2). :rocket:

lina_cs: Great. Action items: jamal (deploy + metrics), matt (eval run + routing file), zoe (survey + enablement). Post daily snapshots here.
